description: Reporting period and statement nodes for a capital structure summary.

cash_node.description:
Statement node holding the cash balance at the end of each period.
Omitted, the summary has no cash, net debt or net leverage.

ebitda_node.description:
Statement node holding EBITDA for each single period (not already
trailing). Never inferred from a conventional name.

period.description: Reporting period: balances are read at it and the LTM window ends at it.

title: CapitalStructureSummaryConfig
